name: organizations
sql:
CREATE TABLE organizations (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	dataset_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	participation_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	local_model_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	local_model_accuracy FLOAT, 
	current_round INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_update VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	joined_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	privacy_mode VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	data_distribution_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: training_rounds
sql:
CREATE TABLE training_rounds (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	round_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	started_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	completed_at VARCHAR(32), 
	duration_s INTEGER, 
	participating_clients INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_clients INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	accuracy FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	loss FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	f1 FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	aggregation_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: validation_tests
sql:
CREATE TABLE validation_tests (
	id VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expected_result TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actual_result TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	execution_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(32), 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: client_participations
sql:
CREATE TABLE client_participations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	round_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	local_accuracy FLOAT, 
	local_loss FLOAT, 
	samples_used INTEGER, 
	duration_s INTEGER, 
	update_size_mb FLOAT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(round_id) REFERENCES training_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: model_versions
sql:
CREATE TABLE model_versions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	round_id INTEGER, 
	accuracy FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	loss FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	f1 FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	false_positive_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	is_global BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(round_id) REFERENCES training_rounds (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: threat_detections
sql:
CREATE TABLE threat_detections (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	org_id VARCHAR(32), 
	organization_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	threat_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	source_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	destination_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	protocol VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	port INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	raw_features_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	detection_method VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: metrics
sql:
CREATE TABLE metrics (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	metric_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	metric_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	model_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	org_id VARCHAR(32), 
	round_number INTEGER, 
	category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: privacy_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE privacy_events (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	org_id VARCHAR(32), 
	event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	detail TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
